name: Israel Israeli
headline: Junior Data Scientist
professional_profile: Data scientist with 3 years of experience turning product and operations data into models that ship. Comfortable across the full loop: SQL extraction, pandas feature work, scikit-learn modeling, and putting models behind a simple API. Looking to grow on a product-facing data science team.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Built a churn prediction model (gradient boosting, scikit-learn) for a B2B subscription product; used by the customer success team to prioritize weekly outreach.
Wrote SQL and pandas pipelines over ~50M event rows to build user-level features; cut feature build time from hours to minutes.
Packaged models as a FastAPI service in Docker and set up a weekly retraining job with basic drift checks.
Ran A/B test analyses for pricing page experiments and presented results to product managers.

experience.title: Junior Data Analyst
bullets: Built demand forecasting baselines (linear models, seasonal decomposition) for warehouse staffing.
Owned recurring SQL reports and dashboards (Tableau) for operations leadership.
Automated data quality checks in Python, catching missing and duplicate shipment records before reporting.

projects.name: Delivery ETA estimation
projects.description: Regression model predicting delivery times from route and weather features; scikit-learn pipeline with cross-validation, served as a small REST endpoint.

projects.name: Hebrew review sentiment
projects.description: Text classification on public product reviews with TF-IDF and logistic regression, plus a short comparison against a pretrained transformer.
